title: Cognitive intelligence-enabled requirements elicitation for design optimisation of smart product-service system
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a cognitive intelligence-enabled framework for requirements elicitation in smart product-service systems (SPSS) to enhance design optimisation. It integrates digital twin technology, deep learning, and model interpretation to extract and interpret usage data, leading to optimised design requirements.

evaluations.sample_description: Five experts engaged in wind turbine design, operation and maintenance were invited to evaluate the assistance role of the proposed framework in actual engineering.
